items.t: Said he supports the federal action on ghost guns and is proud of the Illinois legislation passed to stop ghost guns.
items.q: I am supportive of today’s federal action and remain proud of the life-saving legislation that we passed to stop ghost guns from harming more of our family, friends, and neighbors.

items.t: Said that not paying people for work done with public dollars violates the state's prompt payments act.
items.q: We have a prompt payments act with the state government that if there are public dollars involved, and somebody is doing work and not getting paid, that's a violation of the law,

items.t: Said Waymo beginning initial mapping and manual testing in Chicago is a vital step toward safer streets and more accessible transportation.
items.q: Chicago is leading the future of mobility by welcoming Waymo to begin initial mapping and manual testing in the city," Kam Buckner, speaker pro tempore of the Illinois House of Representatives, said in a statement.

items.t: Said he thinks the Bears are bluffing and using this as a point of leverage.
items.q: I think the Bears are bluffing. I think that this is once again a point of leverage for them, but I could see this ending pretty badly,

record.t: Sponsored legislation to ban the sale and possession of ghost guns in Illinois, which the General Assembly approved.
record.q: state lawmakers approved legislation Saturday pushed by Sheriff Dart and sponsored by state Sen. Jacqueline Collins and state Rep. Kam Buckner to ban the sale and possession of ghost guns in Illinois.

record.t: Posted on X that Chicago and many Illinois cities have a self-inflicted housing crisis that his House Bill 4795 aims to address.
record.q: posted on X, formerly Twitter, that Chicago and many cities in Illinois have a self-inflicted housing crisis, something his House Bill 4795 aims to address.

record.t: Introduced a House resolution calling on the Illinois Auditor General's office to audit state funds that go to the district for athletics.
record.q: Buckner introduced a resolution in the House calling on the Illinois Auditor General’s office to conduct an audit of state funds that go to the district for athletics.
